title: Atlas UI and Operator Workflow
objective: Deliver the usable map-to-vector and vector-to-map product as a code-backed UI contract: a serializable view-model the browser UI binds to, plus the operator-workflow spec. The live browser UI is untestable in this environment, so it stays spec-level.

repository_truth.head: de620bb
reused_engine: cwatlas.r1082.overlay_spec.build_overlay_state (two-layer-root globe layers) + candidate_ensemble.build_candidate_map (agreement surface / alias set) + geocode_forward (decoded candidate) - NOT reimplemented

implementation.browser_ui: OUT_OF_SCOPE_SPEC_LEVEL_ONLY - node exists but the live browser UI is untestable; the UI contract is code-backed and tested via the view-model

claims.statement: build_view_model(epoch, shell) produces the deterministic, serializable view-model the Atlas UI binds to: controls with their domains, assumptions stated before execution, the two-layer-root globe overlay, a decoded-candidate panel (pins/region/alias set), and the agreement/alias-set surface across the retained families - with no hidden defaults.

negative_results: The live browser UI is untestable here and is delivered as a spec (ATLAS_UI_SPEC.md); the testable deliverable is the code-backed view-model.
No hidden defaults: every control value is in control_values and every assumption in assumptions, shown before any encode/decode runs.

Ambiguity is always a region or alias set with an agreement surface (per-cell variance / angular dispersion), never collapsed to a false-exact point; candidate_panel.rendered_as_measured is always false.
The FIXED Wilkes root layer is epoch-independent; out of field-model validity the overlay yields a typed MODEL_VALIDITY_REFUSAL, never an invented direction.
Training anchors (Wilkes fixed root, Stonehenge) are surfaced distinctly and are never scored as holdout predictions; locked decisions are not reopened.
privacy_check: CLEAN - synthetic/public epochs, shells, routes and the synthetic public Stonehenge coordinate only; opaque anchor id only; no private path literals, no identity tokens, no raw private narrative
